PREFACE.
This is a compauion volume to the Khasi- English ‘Dictionary
» by the same author which was published by Government in 1806.
In his letter dated the 1st February 1907 to Government the
author wrote : — •
** So far as the arrangement of the English words is concerned, I claim
no originality in the matter ; they have been put down as ^ they are in an
ordinuy popular English Dictionary. The pronunciations in English have
specially been given to meet the wants of Khasi students.’'
Agreeably to the sanction conveyed in Government letter
No. 44460., dated the 30th March 1907, the late U Nissor Singh
prepared the manuscript of this Dictionary which was revised by
a Committee composed of the following gentlemen : —
r (Mr. F. E. Jackson,
The Deputy Commissioner < Mr. L. O. Clarke and
C Mr. B. C. Allen).
Rai Sahib Dohory Ropmay,
XJ Hajom Eissor Singh,
D Nissor Singh (the author).
The Committee were assisted by the following gentlemen to
each of whom was allotted for revision the manuscript of one or
more letters of the Alphabet ; — •
The Rev. Walter Firminger (now Arch-Deacon of
Calcutta),
The late Rev. C. L. Stephens,
The Rev. J. C. Evans, and
Khan Sahib Amjad AU.
to whom the best thanks of the Committee are due.
After having been passed by the Revision Committee the
manusoripts were sent to the Secretariat Press letter by letter.
The author read the proofs from the letter A to part of O
which were sent to him from time to time as they were issued

from the Press until bis death at Tura, Garo Hills, which took
place on the 20th February 1918 at the age of 48 years. The
proofs cf the remaining letters were read by TJ H. K. Singh who
also wrote the Key to pronu nciation and the lists of abbrevia-
tions. ^
The author was an enthusiast in tho cause of education* the
following being a list of his works —
The Khasi-English Dictiionary (published by the Assad
Secretariat Press.)
Hints on the Study of the Khasi Language.
Khasi Arithmetic.
Hhasi Mental Arithmetic.
Mental Arithmetic in the Garo Langiiage (not publi-
shed).
Ka skul bad U Nonghikai (The School and the
Teacher), published by the Hi Khasi Press* Mawkhar*
Shillong,
It is hoped that this book will supply a long-felt want and
will^erve as a good foundation for any improvomente which may
be made in the future.
Shillong :
September 1920.
A. W. DENTITH*
Deputy Commikiioner,
Khasi and Jainiia Hills.
